headline: RBI to conduct ₹50,000 crore 3-day VRR auction under LAF on October 23, 2026
summary_points: RBI will hold a 3-day Variable Rate Repo (VRR) auction under LAF on Friday, October 23, 2026.
The decision follows a review of current and evolving near-term liquidity conditions.
Operational guidelines remain as per Press Release 2021-2022/1572 dated January 20, 2022.
who_is_affected: Banks and other LAF-eligible participants, along with treasury teams tracking short-term liquidity and money market rates.
action_required: Eligible participants wishing to bid should do so within the 9:30-10:00 AM window on October 23, 2026, following the 2022 operational guidelines.

social.linkedin:
RBI has announced a 3-day Variable Rate Repo (VRR) auction under the Liquidity Adjustment Facility (LAF) for Friday, October 23, 2026.

Key details:
• Notified amount: ₹50,000 crore
• Tenor: 3 days
• Bidding window: 9:30 AM to 10:00 AM
• Date of reversal: Monday, October 26, 2026

The central bank said the move follows a review of current and evolving near-term liquidity conditions. Operational guidelines remain the same as those in Press Release 2021-2022/1572 dated January 20, 2022.

For treasury teams, banks and finance professionals, this is a signal worth tracking for short-term liquidity and money market conditions.

Please verify the details with the official RBI press release (2026-2027/1370) before acting.
